requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Loaded the current public Bhu-Naksha viewer.
Inspected current JavaScript; public routes include ScalarDatahandler, rest/Levels, rest/MapInfo, and WMS.
Returned the selector markup; district option 30 BUXAR was present.
Returned Buxar subdivision options, including 01 बक्सर and 02 डुमराँव.
Returned Buxar subdivision circles including 01 Buxar, 04 Chausa, 03 Itarhi, and 02 Rajpur.
Returned the Buxar-circle mauza list; no mauza named Buxar was present in the returned list excerpt/full response search.
Partial circle selection returned no extent; this is a route/selection limitation, not evidence of citywide absence.
Official Bihar service landing page confirms cadastral mapping purpose and Directorate custodian.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official viewer provides Bihar district/subdivision/circle/mauza cadastral-map navigation.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Buxar district and Buxar subdivision/circle metadata only; no parcel polygon or citywide geometry coverage verified.

qualityAssessment.identity: No parcel-native identity was returned in the bounded metadata requests

blocker: The public viewer is selector-driven and the tested partial extent route returned HTTP 204; no safe anonymous geometry response was obtained. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, or unsafe land-record fields were requested.
remainingUncertainty: Buxar city may be represented by one or more mauzas/map instances not resolved in this bounded pass; exact-point miss or lack of polygon access cannot establish absence or citywide coverage.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently qualify an anonymous polygon route and native parcel identity before adapter admission; keep runtime integration held.
